shared_elements: rounded-topped stone surface with carved outline motifs
horizontal band of repeated small units across the lower/middle area
vertical linear elements in the upper zone
justification: The only real correspondence is generic: both surfaces carry schematic incised/low-relief linework organised around a horizontal band of repeated small units set below upper vertical elements, on a rounded-topped field. What is actually depicted differs fundamentally: A shows an abstract composition of a mast-like cross, a row of rectangles and a zigzag register (readable as a vessel or structure), while B is an anthropomorphic figure with face, ears, arms and paired disc/spiral motifs plus a belt-like band, none of which appear in A.
